selected_evidence.requirement: Require new passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least three character classes
selected_evidence.summary: Shows minlen=12 and minclass=3, PAM integration, rejection tests for each violated requirement, compliant-password acceptance, and post-restart persistence.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change and post-restart evidence both show RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 31949c21-52ad-47af-bdbe-893352fd509b, reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID 43e1b76d-7dc0-49f1-bf43-9cd36c6edc1d, running system with no failed units, and recovered policy enforcement.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r

rpm -q pam libpwquality authselect 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- authselect ---'
authselect current 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- pwquality effective config ---'
grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*(minlen|minclass|[duol]credit)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- pam pwquality lines ---'
grep -RHE '^[^#].*pam_pwquality\.so' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- core health ---'
systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>&1 || true

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d
cat > /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Require passwords to be at least 12 characters and span at least 3 classes.
minlen = 12
minclass = 3
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
restorecon /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
sed -n '1,20p' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
commands.stdout:
-rw-r--r-- root:root /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
# Require passwords to be at least 12 characters and span at least 3 classes.
minlen = 12
minclass = 3

commands.command:
set +e
run_case() {
  case_name=$1
  candidate=$2
  output=$(printf '%s\n' "$candidate" | pwscore 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  printf '%s rc=%s output=%s\n' "$case_name" "$rc" "$output"
}
run_case short_four_classes 'Az7!quar'
run_case long_two_classes 'abcdefghijklMN'
run_case compliant_four_classes 'Az7!quartzRiver'
printf '%s\n' '--- PAM consumers ---'
grep -H 'pam_pwquality\.so' /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth
printf '%s\n' '--- policy file ---'
cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
